svg.aria-label: Shuttle, a crab, walks along a long table of numbered cells, 0 to 15, colored in a repeating pattern of 4. Dashed arcs mark its hops: from cell 1 to 5, to 9, to 13, always 4 cells at a time, and it fills every cell it lands on. 3 more crabs further back would cover the other colors. A tag reads i, i + stride, i + 2 stride: the grid-stride loop.
